ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, on the left there is a central skeletal carbon, extending one carbon skeleton line each toward the upper left, horizontally to the left, and lower left; this central carbon is also connected to the nitrogen atom labeled N to the right. On the right side of the nitrogen atom, a multiple-bond representation connected to the right carbon is drawn, and the right carbon is further connected by a single bond to the far-right carbon. The curved arrows and charge symbols in the figure are not counted as bonds. Then reason: according to the question, exclude hydrogen-related bonds, and only count connections between non-hydrogen atoms. From the left central carbon to three carbon endpoints, there are 3 C–C single bonds in total; from the central carbon to nitrogen there is 1 C–N bond; the multiple bond from nitrogen to the right carbon is counted as 1 heavy-atom bond connection; from the right carbon to the far-right carbon there is 1 C–C single bond. Therefore the total is 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 6.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image first and list every non-hydrogen bond connection. Count the three left-side C–C single bonds from the central skeletal carbon, add the C–N bond to the labeled nitrogen, add the N-to-right-carbon multiple bond as one heavy-atom bond connection, and add the right-carbon-to-terminal-carbon single bond. Sum these included connections to obtain 6.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧有一个中心骨架碳，向左上、左侧水平、左下各连出一条碳骨架线；该中心碳还向右连接到标有 N 的氮原子。氮原子右侧画有与右侧碳相连的多重键表示，右侧碳再通过一条单键连到最右端碳。图中的弯箭头和电荷符号不作为键计数。
再推理：按题意排除氢相关键，只数非氢原子之间的连接。左侧中心碳到三个碳端点共有 3 个 C–C 单键；中心碳到氮有 1 个 C–N 键；氮到右侧碳的多重键作为 1 个重原子键连接计数；右侧碳到最右端碳有 1 个 C–C 单键。因此总数为 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 6。
